expectations.text: Covers FROM and SUBJECT lines (FROM identifies sender; caution with 'free' and spam filters)
Lead with a strong headline/benefit up front
First paragraph is a mini-version of the whole message with offer and response link
Expanded copy follows with features, benefits, proof; repeat offer and response mechanism at close (multiple links)
Formatting/tone tips: wide margins, sparing all caps, short is generally better, helpful not hard-sell
Includes opt-out statement and/or deliverability notes; flags the 2005 edition may be dated
